summary_en: Dividend restoration: ¥3.00 per share (period-end), FY9/26. No interim dividend. Prior year (FY9/25): ¥0.00. Rationale: popup-store business momentum (sales ~160% of prior-year level as of May; 22 new outlets YTD vs. 32 full-year prior); improved earnings outlook.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Restoration) for the Fiscal Year Ending September 2026
translation_en_brief:
Shinozakiya resolved on 30 June 2026 to restore dividend payments for the fiscal year ending September 2026, setting a period-end dividend of ¥3.00 per share (no interim dividend). The prior fiscal year (FY9/25) and the previous forecast (announced 7 November 2025) both envisioned zero dividend.

The company restated its commitment to stable, sustainable dividend policy while balancing shareholder returns against financial strength. To enable resumption, the company executed treasury-share cancellation in FY9/25 and planned capital reduction and surplus disposition in FY9/26.

The primary driver is strong momentum in the popup-store business, a newer revenue stream. As of end-May FY9/26, popup outlets numbered 22 (vs. 32 for the full prior year), but sales reached approximately 160% of the prior-year level, driven by better-located sites and one new long-term contract. The company expects continued demand for new popup locations, indicating the business model is establishing a solid operational foundation.
